name: co.skillsandagents/catalog-mcp
title: Skills and Agents Catalog
description: Search and fetch skills from your org's Skills and Agents catalog and the public catalog. Requires a bearer token from your org's Marketplace token settings page.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token minted from your org's Marketplace token settings page in the Skills and Agents app. Format: 'Bearer sam_...'. Required on every request; there is no anonymous access.

tools.name: search_skills
tools.description: Search your org's private skills plus the public catalog by keyword, and get back a ranked list of matches with slug, title, description, category, and how to install each one.

tools.name: get_skill
tools.description: Look up one skill by its slug and get its full details plus an install command. The command has a placeholder for your token; the skill body itself is never returned.
